theory: The velocity fact incorrectly identifies the signed integral as distance without requiring nonnegative velocity: it gives displacement, while distance is the integral of speed, with sign-changing intervals split and absolute areas added. Likewise, replace 'displacement subtracts them' with an explicit statement that displacement is area above the axis minus area below it, so an entirely negative velocity gives negative displacement. Volume-from-cross-section and solving unknown limits are not supported question types in this booklet and must not be presented as its assessed procedures.
